unit_label: BRBL C U01: Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2021 (30 June 2026 snapshot) — Identify public-information, nodal-officer and RBI suspension duties within the 2021 framework

facts.locator: printed pp.226,231; PDF page = printed page + 19
facts.statement: Courseware describes appointment/receipt arrangements and RBI suspension; primary source adds the detailed public-information obligations.

RBI may order suspension of all or any clauses generally or for specified RE and extend suspension. Clause18 requires Principal Nodal Officer not below GM/equivalent, defined information/representation role, branch/public-language display, scheme availability on request and updated website details.

payload.title: Public information and a nodal role support the complaint process
payload.core_explanation_md:
The 2021 scheme requires a Principal Nodal Officer at the stated seniority, responsible for representation and furnishing information. The entity also has branch and website information duties: prominent contact/portal details, salient features in the stated languages and a scheme copy available for customer reference. Naming an officer internally does not by itself perform those public-information duties.

RBI suspension under clause 2 is a different matter. It requires an RBI order and may concern all or specified clauses, generally or for a specified entity, with the stated extension power. An entity cannot create its own scheme suspension merely because its nodal officer is absent or its complaint queue is busy.

self_check.prompt_text: Can an RE suspend the scheme itself simply because the appointed nodal officer is unavailable?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Clause 2 addresses RBI ordered suspension, while the entity information and staffing arrangements need their own compliance.

payload.stem_md: An RE appoints a Principal Nodal Officer but omits the required public contact/portal and scheme information. It treats the appointment alone as complete clause18 compliance. What distinction is missing?

options.text_md: The officer appointment automatically counts as every branch display
options.explanation_md: Internal appointment does not itself display the information to customers.

options.text_md: A website alone necessarily replaces every stated branch obligation
options.explanation_md: The scheme describes separate public-information duties.

options.text_md: A customer must already know the officer details before any duty exists
options.explanation_md: The provision requires the entity to make the stated information available.

options.text_md: Appointment, public display, scheme-copy availability and website updating are distinct duties
options.explanation_md: A single appointment record does not establish completion of all those requirements.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A single appointment record does not establish completion of all those requirements.

payload.stem_md: A bank announces that it has suspended the entire 2021 scheme for itself because its complaint queue is unusually large. Which clause2 feature is missing?

options.text_md: The branch may replace every RBI order with an internal queue notice
options.explanation_md: An internal notice is not the RBI suspension order contemplated by the clause.

options.text_md: The relevant suspension is by RBI order under the stated scope and conditions
options.explanation_md: Operational pressure alone does not establish that RBI ordered suspension.

options.text_md: An internal board resolution alone lets the bank opt out without an RBI order
options.explanation_md: The entity internal resolution is not the RBI suspension order contemplated by clause2.

options.text_md: Sending the bank suspension notice to CRPC necessarily proves RBI approved it
options.explanation_md: Sending a notice does not itself establish the required RBI order or its scope.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Operational pressure alone does not establish that RBI ordered suspension.
